_readme: Senior HCBS waiver or LTSS program per state, used by engines/seed-data.js for states not hand-written in SENIOR_WAIVERS. 1915(c) entries come from each state's Medicaid.gov waiver factsheet (the aged/disabled waiver serving people 65+); 1115 managed-LTSS states link the state Medicaid page. An "al" entry exists only when the program's listed services include assisted living or a similar residential setting. All URLs loaded in Chromium on 2026-11-15.

hc.name: Elderly and Disabled (E&D) Waiver
hc.fact: Medicaid.gov's waiver list shows Alabama's Elderly and Disabled (E&D) Waiver (waiver 0068.R08.00) providing adult day health with transportation, homemaker, personal care, skilled respite and adult companion service, among other services, to people 65 or older and adults with disabilities who meet a nursing facility level of care.

hc.name: Alaskans Living Independently (ALI) Waiver
hc.fact: Medicaid.gov's waiver list shows Alaska's Alaskans Living Independently (ALI) Waiver (waiver 0261.R07.00) providing adult day, respite, host home care, environmental modification and meals, among other services, to people 65 or older and adults with disabilities who meet a nursing facility level of care.

al.name: Alaskans Living Independently (ALI) Waiver

Its listed services include residential supported living; Medicaid waivers do not pay room and board.

hc.name: Arizona Long Term Care System (ALTCS)
hc.fact: Arizona runs senior long-term care through the Arizona Long Term Care System (ALTCS), part of AHCCCS (Arizona Medicaid), rather than a separate 1915(c) waiver. ALTCS covers people with an age-related or physical disability who require a nursing facility level of care, and services may be provided in an institution or in a home or community-based setting.

Besides nursing home care, it covers home and community-based services such as adult day care, home-delivered meals, personal care, personal emergency response systems and respite care.
